planning_candidates: cleaning or transport, same earliest jointly admissible slot
filter_fit: lognormal service rounded up to 15min and independent exponential reporting lag, completed likelihood plus censored no-arrival likelihood
calibration_primary: Brier and fixed-bin calibration of unfinished public services; MAE free beds and cleaning/transport counts
decision_primary: paired patient-minutes observed planner minus filtered planner, bootstrap by structure, per delay
knowledge_scope: All prospective planners share simulator structural parameters. Only true-state planner sees current true state. Future draws and hidden regime innovations are independent from evaluated futures.
selection: No test-outcome selection of structures or hyperparameters. Log initial candidate cost gaps and action differences.
